Definition: to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to knock, strike, bring down; 1a) (Qal) to strike down; 1b) (Niphal) to be thrust after, be impelled; 1c) (Piel) to strike at, take aim at; 1d) (Hithpael) to be struck; 2) (CLBL) to ensnare; 2a) (Qal) to ensnare; 2b) (Niphal) to be ensnared; 2c) (Piel) to lay snares; 2d) (Hithpael) to lay snares
